in_sanskrit.name: रहीम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who bestows protection and shows mercy, compassion, and kindness.

in_hindi.name: रहीस
in_hindi.meaning: राहे हुए (one who is on the path, journey)
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is on the path or journey of providing protection and showing mercy, compassion, and kindness.

in_tamil.name: ரஹீஸ
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who removes obstacles and shows mercy, compassion, and kindness.

in_telugu.name: రహీస
in_telugu.meaning: రెప్పు దేశ్యము (one who is the lord of mercy)
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is the lord of mercy and shows compassion, kindness, and protection.

in_marathi.name: Rahees
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rahees हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। He who rides or travels.

in_bengali.name: Rahees
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Rider, Traveller
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rahees একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। He who rides or travels.
